description: This is a FastAPI router module that provides CRUD operations for managing course notes, including creation with AI integration, retrieval (individual and list with pagination), update, and deletion. It handles YouTube video transcripts, summaries, and user access controls.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: ORM model representing a note, including fields for transcript, summary, video title, duration, and ownership.

classes.name: AIService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with AI models for content summarization and analysis.

methods.name: create_note( note_data: NoteCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Creates a new note, extracts YouTube transcript, and optionally generates AI summaries.

methods.name: get_user_notes( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search in title and content") )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notes owned by the current user, with optional search.

methods.name: get_note( note_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID, checking access permissions.

methods.name: update_note( note_id: int, note_update: NoteUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note, restricted to the owner.

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Deletes a note if the current user is the owner.

methods.name: get_public_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size") )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of public notes.

search-terms: Notes CRUD with AI and YouTube

ctags.signature: ( note_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.signature: ( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search in title and content") )
